parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You extract structured data from a message about a Dubai apartment lease renewal.

Respond with ONLY one JSON object - no markdown fences and no commentary - with exactly these keys:
area: area name in Dubai as stated or best inferred, or an empty string if unknown
areaSlug: lowercase hyphenated Bayut area slug (examples: dubai-marina, downtown-dubai, jumeirah-lake-towers, business-bay, palm-jumeirah, dubai-hills-estate, jumeirah-beach-residence, al-barsha, the-greens, motor-city, al-furjan, deira, bur-dubai), or an empty string if the area cannot be resolved
bedrooms: integer number of bedrooms (0 for a studio)
bathrooms: integer number of bathrooms, or 0 if not stated
areaSqft: integer size in square feet, or 0 if not stated
annualRentAED: the CURRENT annual rent in AED as an integer - accept formats like 160k, 160,000 or a monthly figure which you multiply by 12 - or 0 if not stated
searchUrl: https://www.bayut.com/for-rent/property/dubai/<areaSlug>/ when areaSlug is known, otherwise https://www.bayut.com/for-rent/property/dubai/

USER MESSAGE:
' + ($json.chatInput || '') }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ searchUrl: (() => { const raw = $('K2 Parse Request').first().json.choices[0].message.content || ''; const m = raw.match(/"searchUrl"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/); const fallback = 'https://www.bayut.com/for-rent/property/dubai/'; return (m && m[1] && m[1].indexOf('bayut.com') > -1) ? m[1] : fallback; })(), maxItems: 24 }) }}

assignments.name: compsJson
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const all = $('Apify Fetch Bayut Comps').all().map(i => i.json); const src = (all.length && Array.isArray(all[0])) ? all[0] : ((all.length && all[0] && all[0].data && Array.isArray(all[0].data.items)) ? all[0].data.items : all); const items = src.filter(i => i && (i.price !== undefined || i.priceFormatted || i.listingUrl || i.url)); return JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 24).map(i => ({ price: i.price, priceFormatted: i.priceFormatted || i.price, bedrooms: i.bedrooms, bathrooms: i.bathrooms, area: i.area, listingUrl: i.listingUrl || i.url || '' }))); })() }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You are a Dubai rental market analyst advising a tenant about a lease renewal.

TENANT LEASE DATA (JSON with area, bedrooms, bathrooms, areaSqft, annualRentAED):
' + ($json.leaseData || '') + '

COMPARABLE LISTINGS (JSON array, live results from Bayut for this area):
' + ($json.compsJson || '') + '

Produce a concise market verdict:
1. VERDICT: fair, above market, or below market.
2. PERCENTAGE: the approximate percentage difference between the annual rent and the median of the comparable listings - state the median value.
3. EVIDENCE: cite 3 to 5 specific comparable listings with price, bedrooms, area and listing URL.
4. RECOMMENDED RANGE: a reasonable target annual rent range in AED for the negotiation.

Only use the listings provided - never invent listings or prices. If the comparable list is empty, say clearly that live data was unavailable and give a cautious qualitative answer based only on the lease data. Keep the whole analysis under 250 words.' }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You draft polite, persuasive rent renewal negotiation emails for tenants in Dubai.

USER CONTEXT (original message):
' + $('Shape Market Data').first().json.userMessage + '

MARKET ANALYSIS:
' + $('K2 Fairness Verdict').first().json.choices[0].message.content + '

COMPARABLE LISTINGS (JSON):
' + $('Shape Market Data').first().json.compsJson + '

Draft a professional, respectful email in English to the landlord about the rent renewal. Requirements:
- Reference specific comparable listings as evidence, with prices and listing URLs where useful.
- If the rent is above market, request a reduction or a capped increase, citing the evidence.
- If the rent is fair, confirm the renewal warmly.
- If the rent is below market, acknowledge the landlord position while seeking stability.
- Culturally appropriate for Dubai: courteous, formal, no legal threats, no ultimatums.
- Under 250 words. Include a subject line. Sign off as: Kind regards, [Your Name].

Return ONLY the email text (subject line plus body), no commentary.' }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You are a professional English-to-Arabic translator specialising in UAE business correspondence.

Translate the following English negotiation email into Modern Standard Arabic - formal, polished and respectful, suitable for correspondence with a landlord in Dubai. Keep every fact, number, price and URL exactly as written. Do not add or remove content.

ENGLISH EMAIL:

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You are the final quality gate for a bilingual rent renewal email for a Dubai tenant.

You receive a draft containing: the Arabic translation, a line containing only ---ENGLISH GLOSS---, and an English gloss.

Check:

2. The tone is polite and respectful, with no aggressive, offensive or legally risky content.
3. The Arabic and the English gloss are consistent with each other.

If everything passes, return the final approved text unchanged: the Arabic translation, then the line ---ENGLISH GLOSS---, then the English gloss. If you find issues, fix them minimally and return the corrected text in exactly the same format. Return ONLY the final text - no commentary and no markdown fences.

DRAFT TRANSLATION + GLOSS:
' + $('K2 Translate Arabic').first().json.choices[0].message.content }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## How to run

1. Create two credentials (n8n UI > Credentials > Add credential > "Header Auth"):
   - IFM K2 Horizon API: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <your K2 API key>
   - Apify API: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <your Apify token>
2. Open each HTTP Request node and select the matching credential in the Credential dropdown (K2 nodes = IFM credential, Apify node = Apify credential).
3. Open the chat (Chat panel or Chat Hub) and describe your home, e.g.
   i live in dubai marina, 1 bed / 1 bath, 900 sq ft. i pay aed 160k / yr
4. At the review step, paste your edited email or type APPROVE.

K2 calls target https://api.ifm.ai/v1/chat/completions with model IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B.

## Scraping risk

Bayut uses DataDome anti-bot protection. If the scrape returns a captcha page or no items, swap the actor for get_anything/bayut-property-scraper (Camoufox based, about 6 USD per 1,000 results) and keep the same flat input: searchUrl plus maxItems.

## Human review

This step pauses the execution until you reply in the chat. Paste your edited email, or type APPROVE to keep the draft. The default wait limit is 45 minutes.
